## Definitions

- [statement] Funding is not synchronized across venues, so some practitioners trade perp against perp with no spot leg: long where funding is negative, short where it is neutral or positive. askrubyai lists the costs: margin on two venues, different settlement timing (Binance every 8 hours, Hyperliquid hourly) and one leg liquidating before the other. It reports no PnL for the idea. (low confidence) — https://askrubyai.github.io/blog/posts/2026-02-14-funding-rate-arbitrage · keywords: Funding rate arbitrage and delta-neutral yield including Ethena USDe · also: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/trading/funding

## How it works

- [statement] USDe's backing is hedged by short BTC/ETH perpetual futures on centralized exchanges, and yield to stakers comes from funding on those shorts, staking yield on LST collateral, short-dated futures basis, and interest on liquid stablecoin/Treasury-like holdings; the mix shifts toward stables when funding falls below Treasury yields. (medium confidence) — https://docs.ethena.fi/solution-overview/risks/funding-risk · keywords: Funding rate arbitrage and delta-neutral yield including Ethena USDe · also: https://stablecoininsider.org/ethena-usde-q1-2026-report/
- [statement] Funding-rate arbitrage holds spot (or a staked asset) long against an equal short perpetual and earns the funding that longs pay shorts when the perp trades above spot. Funding is a peer-to-peer transfer between traders (Hyperliquid's docs: no fee is collected on it). Ethena's USDe runs this trade at scale: its short BTC/ETH perps sit on centralized exchanges while the backing assets stay with off-exchange settlement providers such as Copper, Ceffu and Fireblocks. sUSDe yield comes from funding, staking yield on LST collateral, short-dated futures basis and interest on liquid stablecoins, and Ethena moves backing into stablecoins earning about the Treasury rate when funding is low or negative. (high confidence) — https://docs.ethena.fi/solution-overview/risks/funding-risk · keywords: Funding rate arbitrage and delta-neutral yield including Ethena USDe · also: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/trading/funding, https://www.llamarisk.com/research/bybit-incident-post-mortem-ethena-s-risk-mitigation-and-resilience, https://stablecoininsider.org/ethena-usde-q1-2026-report/, https://docs.ethena.fi/backing-custody-and-security/overview/off-exchange-settlement-in-detail

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Vine's cross-sectional variant (long low-funding, short high-funding perps, dollar-neutral, weekly) is the only funding strategy in that study to survive costs out of sample, and thinly: net Sharpe 0.71 in-sample, 0.39 purged walk-forward, deflated Sharpe 0.63, probability of backtest overfitting 0.81, max drawdown -35%, +1.7% through the Oct 2025 cascade window. (low confidence) — https://bryanvine.github.io/alpha-research/paper2.html · keywords: Funding rate arbitrage and delta-neutral yield including Ethena USDe
